  - An efficient method to monitor the flow of the polling process through forms set up by accrediting organizations
  - A means of quickly reporting other problematic issues outside the standard forms

The Vote Monitor App can be used during any type of election in any country worldwide. Since 2016, it has been used in multiple election rounds in Romania and Poland.

Please note that if you are not accredited as an independent observer by an organization that monitors election processes in your country, you cannot use the Vote Monitor app. Please refer to such organizations to learn what steps you need to take to become an electoral observer or contact us for further information at info@commitglobal.org.
